note: USACE Coralville Lake campground on a point on the west side of the dam: a back-in loop at the tip of the point backs onto the riprap shore, an electric/water loop sits above the swim beach and boat ramp, and the rest are wooded loops inland. --Claude
summary: Fees $22-28 confirmed (four peak templates; 2026-2028 unchanged); electric 50 -> 30 (catalog: 30 amp on 88 sites), water confirmed on 19; max rig 60 -> 73, 89 back-in sites; facilities flush toilets/dump/water added; season May 1 - Oct 17 added; booking 14-night max; lakefront stands.
flags: ELECTRIC 50 -> 30: the per-site catalog lists 30 amp on 88 of 89 sites (one 'Electricity Hookup' with no amperage); no 50-amp site. The old note's '20/30A, some 50A' is not supported.

WATERFRONT 'lakefront' STANDS (checked): the catalog coordinates put back-in pads W47, W49, W50 and W51 at the tip of the point ~30-35 m from open water across an unused riprap apron with only a footpath between; W52-W58 on the west side face a brushy slope to a cove. The point is on the lake side of the dam, so the below-dam rule does not apply. Most other loops are inland in woods.
SEASON: the rates (and so reservations) run May 1 - October 17; the RIDB phone line says the campground is staffed May 1 - October 31. Written 05-01 to 10-17.
PHONE: none stored; RIDB gives 319-338-3685 in season (May 1 - Oct 31) and the Coralville Lake Project Office 319-338-3543 x6300 otherwise (apply.py does not write phone).
WEBSITE: the stored second line (mvr.usace.army.mil Coralville Lake) was not re-read; rec.gov line is live.
